text:
Olivia (Finance): Heads up — batch invoicing for this morning produced several invoices with zeroed line items and a few duplicates. Holding on sending out any credits/adjustments until we know root cause. Example invoice IDs: INV-20260102-839, INV-20260102-842, INV-20260102-913. Small CSV snippet from the job output:
```csv
invoice_id,customer,amount,line_count
INV-20260102-839,acme,0,0
INV-20260102-842,stello,0,0
INV-20260102-913,acme,125.00,2
INV-20260102-913,acme,125.00,2
```
Anyone seen this?

Marcus (Billing): Yikes. Confirming duplicate invoice rows for INV-20260102-913 in invoice_items table. My quick query shows two identical inserts at 1764839185 and 1764839190. Looks like a retry path triggered without idempotency. Will investigate.

InvoiceBot: billing-job-v2 finished with status: partial_failure. Error: "write_timeout" to invoices-db.shard3 on 1764839190. Retries=1.

Kira (Engineering): @Marcus @Olivia can you drop the exact job id? I want to check idempotency keys. If retries created duplicates, we can de-dupe and re-run safely. Recommend pausing cron for invoice job until we confirm.

Marcus (Billing): job_id=job-invoice-2026-01-02-08. Cron paused. I'll take a DB snapshot (read-only) and run de-dupe script against invoice_id PKs.

Sana (Payments): From PSP side we see rebill attempts for INV-20260102-913 at 09:01 and 09:02 — PSP returned "duplicate_charge" warnings. We should stop sending webhooks to PSP until we've fixed duplicates, otherwise customers will see multiple charges. @Kira can we block outbound webhooks from the billing job?

Jorge (CS): ACME reported seeing two invoices and an immediate refund. They're upset — asked for ETA. I told them we're investigating and billing is paused. Can someone prioritize a customer note?

Priya (VP Finance): Pause all invoice emails for today's run — do not send credits, collections notices, or automated dunning. This is high priority. Please provide ETA for mitigation.

Kira (Engineering): Rolling back the publish of job-invoice-2026-01-02-08 via feature flag now. ETA ~15m. I'll also run a query to find duplicate invoice_ids and mark the later rows for manual review before any re-run.

Marcus (Billing): Action checklist: 1) DB snapshot taken at 1764839240 2) De-dup script queued (will run after snapshot verification) 3) Outbound webhooks paused 4) Prepare corrected CSV export for customer notifications. I'll reconcile any credits after de-dupe. @Olivia can you draft the customer-facing note?

Olivia (Finance): Draft done — sending to Jorge for quick review, then to Priya for sign-off. Affected accounts I'm tracking: acme, stello, lumine.

InvoiceBot: scheduled rebill job rescheduled for manual run after cleanup. /cc :eyes:

Sana (Payments): I'll hold PSP webhooks and confirm with Marcus once de-dupe is complete.

Kira (Engineering): Update — de-dupe query found 7 invoice_ids with duplicate rows (same PK, different inserted_at). Marking duplicates with tag "duplicate-detected" for manual audit. Will not delete until finance sign-off.

Marcus (Billing): I'll publish a reconciliation report (CSV) by EOD. For immediate priority customers (ACME) we will issue a manual corrected invoice and a short apology note.

Olivia (Finance): Thanks all. Please ping here when de-dupe completes so I can finalize customer messages and the credit/rebill plan. :thumbsup:
